# weka_object_store_attachment (Resource)

Attaches an object store bucket to a filesystem for tiering (bucket's obs_site = local) or snapshots (obs_site = remote). The server decides the resulting mode from the bucket's own site; it is not a request parameter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "weka_object_store_bucket" "tiering" {
  name          = "tiering"
  obs_name      = "tiering"
  obs_site      = "local"
  hostname      = "s3.example.com"
  bucket        = "weka-tiering"
  auth_method   = "AWSSignature4"
  access_key_id = "placeholder-access-key"
  secret_key    = "placeholder-secret-key"
}

resource "weka_object_store_attachment" "tiering" {
  filesystem_id          = weka_filesystem.home.id
  object_store_bucket_id = weka_object_store_bucket.tiering.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filesystem_id` (String) UID of the filesystem to attach the bucket to.
- `object_store_bucket_id` (String) UID of the weka_object_store_bucket to attach.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <filesystem_id>/<object_store_bucket_id>.
- `mode` (String) Resulting attachment mode reported by the cluster: WRITABLE for a local (tiering) bucket, REMOTE for a remote (snapshot) bucket.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by "<filesystem_id>/<object_store_bucket_id>".
terraform import weka_object_store_attachment.tiering fs-uid/bucket-uid
```
